
GENERATE-TAGS-MD
Generate spec/TAGS.md from tags.json

USAGE
  fspec generate-tags-md

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Generate human-readable tag documentation
  $ fspec generate-tags-md
  ✓ Generated spec/TAGS.md from tags.json
✓ Tags grouped by category

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-tags
  fspec register-tag
  fspec validate-tags

NOTES
  • TAGS.md is human-readable documentation
  • tags.json is the machine-readable source of truth
  • Generated file includes all registered tags grouped by category
